Stops the Google Play Store from silently updating Pluto TV back to the official version and wiping out the patch (which would bring the ads back). Works by setting the patched build's version number far ahead of anything on the Store, so…
Mask live ad breaks (black screen + mute)

Masks Pluto TV LIVE/linear commercial breaks, which are real broadcast time stitched into the live feed and cannot be removed (unlike VOD ads, which "Skip ads" deletes outright). During a live break it covers the player with a black screen…

Removes the ads, ad markers, and pause ads from on-demand videos on Pluto TV v17. Live TV ads are part of the broadcast and are not removed. Hook design ported from semicoloncolonel's tv-morphe-patches.
